entries.210aeee2f14590f5: Its long-term vision toward fiscal 2033 sets as its ideal image for ten years from now “a company that creates food categories through deliciousness, enjoyment and newness,” and it is promoting the three-year medium-term management plan “Ebara Reboot 2026,” treating the first three years (fiscal 2024 to 2026) as steps for investment execution and structural transformation. Through “structural transformation” and “growth investment,” it makes building revenue through appropriate allocation of management resources its key policy, and its basic strategies are: “refine existing businesses and domains and pursue higher profitability,” “establish a new growth trajectory through new markets and new value creation,” and “deepen management base reforms not bound by conventional frameworks.”
